Download App Get Started for Free

The Oriental Insurance Company Limited has released the OICL AO Score Card for the Administrative Officer posts on 24th August 2026. The official OICL AO Final Result was announced on 9 July. Candidates who appeared for Phase 1, Phase 2 and Interview stages can check their marks for online exam. The recruitment was conducted to select eligible candidates to fill 300 Administrative Officers (Generalist & Hindi Officer) post. The scorecard shows the marks obtained by candidates in the examination. Candidates should download their scorecard before 18th September and save a copy for future. Read further to get OICL AO scorecard download link, steps to download and more.

OICL AO Score Card 2026 Out @orientalinsurance.org.in

OICL has released the marks for the Administrative Officers (Scale-I) Online Examination. Candidates can check their marks online with their Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth. The OICL AO scorecard is available from 24th August to 18th September 2026. Candidates should check their marks and download their score cards before the closing date and download its copy.

OICL AO Score Card Download Link

The OICL Administrative Officer Scorecard 2026 has been released on 24th August and candidates who appeared for all stages of recruitment process can now view their marks. Candidates can check their marks by clicking on the direct link to download given below and logging in with their required credentials. Candidates should keep their registration details ready before checking the scorecard. It is also advised to download the scorecard and keep a copy for later.

OICL AO Score Card 2026: Click to Download

OICL AO Scorecard 2026: Overview

The recruitment for Administrative Officers (Scale-I) is managed by the HR Department of Oriental Insurance Company Limited. Below is an overview table of the recruitment status & dates :

Particulars Details
Recruitment Body Oriental Insurance Company Limited (OICL)
Post Name Administrative Officer (AO) Scale-I
Total Vacancies 300 (285 Generalist + 15 Hindi Officers)
OICL AO Score Card Status  Released
Scorecard Result Date 24th August 2026
Mode of Application Online
Selection Process Prelims → Mains → Interview
Official Website orientalinsurance.org.in

How To Download OICL AO Score Card 2026?

Downloading the OICL AO score card for Scale 1 Officers is a simple process and you can follow the steps given as under.

  1. Open the browser & go to orientalinsurance.co.in.
  2. Click on the tab of “Careers” located on the homepage.
  3. Look for the link “AO (Generalist & Hindi Officer) Exercise-2025, Score Display For Online Examination”.
  4. Fill your login credentials.
  5. Your OICL AO 2026 score card will open on the screen
  6. Download and save the file.

Details Mentioned on OICL AO Score Card 2026

The OICL AO Score Card for Administrative Officer (Generalist & Hindi Officer) has the candidate’s performance details. Candidates should check all the information carefully after downloading it.

  • Candidate’s name
  • Roll number
  • Registration number
  • Examination name
  • Post name
  • Marks obtained
  • Section-wise marks, wherever applicable
  • Overall marks
  • Qualifying status

OICL AO Exam Dates 2026

Candidates can check the important OICL AO Exam Dates 2026 below. These dates include the Prelims, Mains, Interview, Final Result, Medical Examination & Score Card release dates.

Event Date
Prelims Exam 10 January 2026
Prelims Result 6 February 2026
Mains Exam 28 February 2026
Mains Result 30 April 2026
Interview 22 May to 11 June 2026
Final Result 9 July 2026
Pre-recruitment Medical Examination 13–17 July 2026
OICL AO Score Card 24 August 2026
Closing Date of Score Card 18 September 2026

Why Should Candidates Download the OICL AO Score Card?

The scorecard helps candidates understand their performance in the examination. It shows marks and helps in comparing performance with the required cut off. Candidates should keep a copy of OICL AO scorecard safe.

  • It shows the marks obtained by the candidate.
  • It helps candidates understand their exam performance.
  • It can help in analysing strong and weak areas.
  • It is a documented record of candidate’s marks.
  • Candidates can keep it for future reference.

OICL AO Score Card 2026: FAQs

Question: Is OICL AO marks 2026 Released?

Answer: Yes. The scorecard of OICL AO for Scale I Officers released on 24 August 2026.

Question: What are information is needed to download OICL AO score card?

Answer: Candidates need their registration/roll number and password/DOB to see their online examination marks.

Question: What is the date of declaration of the OICL AO final result 2026?

Answer: The OICL AO final result 2026 has been declared on 9th July.

Question: What is the number of vacancies declared for OICL AO 2026?

Answer: Total 300 vacancies have been declared for OICL AO Scale I.
